description.value: Umé is a family-owned Japanese restaurant tucked into Burtch Plaza on Highway 97 (Harvey Avenue) in Kelowna, serving sushi, sashimi, bento boxes, donburi, and more—all prepared MSG-free with fresh ingredients. It has earned a strong local reputation, landing in TripAdvisor's Top 10 best sushi in Kelowna and holding a 4.7-star Google rating from 360+ reviews. Cyclists riding the Highway 97 corridor have the option to dine in or grab takeout via Skip the Dishes or DoorDash.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and fully corroborates the OSM record's name, address (8-1470 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna), phone (778-484-7566), and category (Japanese restaurant).
